description:
//usercontrol
<usercontrol x: class = "wpfapp1.usercontrol1"
             xmlns = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
             xmlns: x = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns: mc = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
             xmlns: d = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
             xmlns: local = "clr-namespace:wpfapp1"
             mc: ignorable = "d" d: designwidth = "800" height = "320" >
    <grid >
        <grid background = "white" >
            <image horizontalalignment = "left" margin = "10,10,0,0" width = "300" height = "300" verticalalignment = "top" opacitymask = "white" / >
            <textblock x: name = "priceblock" horizontalalignment = "left" margin = "681,36,0,0" textwrapping = "wrap" text = "{binding price}" verticalalignment = "top" width = "109" / >
            <grid margin = "320,10,130,10" background = "#ffbdbdbd" >
                <textblock x: name = "nameblock" horizontalalignment = "left" margin = "10,10,0,0" textwrapping = "wrap" text = "{binding name}" verticalalignment = "top" / >
                <textblock x: name = "typeblock" horizontalalignment = "left" margin = "143,10,0,0" textwrapping = "wrap" text = "{binding idtypenavigation.type1}" verticalalignment = "top" / >
                <textblock x: name = "manufacturerblock" horizontalalignment = "left" margin = "103,31,0,0" textwrapping = "wrap" text = "{binding idmanufacturernavigation.manufacturer1}" verticalalignment = "top" / >
                <textblock x: name = "supplierblock" horizontalalignment = "left" margin = "79,51,0,0" textwrapping = "wrap" text = "{binding idsuppliernavigation.supplier1}" verticalalignment = "top" / >
                <textblock x: name = "renttimeblock" horizontalalignment = "left" margin = "109,72,0,0" textwrapping = "wrap" text = "{binding idrenttimenavigation.renttime1}" verticalalignment = "top" / >
                <textblock x: name = "descriptionblock" horizontalalignment = "center" margin = "0,114,0,0" textwrapping = "wrap" text = "{binding description}" verticalalignment = "top" height = "176" width = "330" / >
                <textblock horizontalalignment = "left" margin = "10,30,0,0" textwrapping = "wrap" text = "производитель:" verticalalignment = "top" / >
                <textblock horizontalalignment = "left" margin = "10,51,0,0" textwrapping = "wrap" text = "поставщик:" verticalalignment = "top" / >
                <textblock horizontalalignment = "left" margin = "10,72,0,0" textwrapping = "wrap" text = "единица аренды:" verticalalignment = "top" / >
                <textblock horizontalalignment = "left" margin = "10,93,0,0" textwrapping = "wrap" text = "описание оборудования:" verticalalignment = "top" / >
            < / grid >
            <label x: name = "pricelabel" content = "цена:" horizontalalignment = "left" margin = "675,10,0,0" verticalalignment = "top" rendertransformorigin = "0.801,0.468" / >
            <textblock x: name = "saleblock" horizontalalignment = "left" margin = "681,160,0,0" textwrapping = "wrap" text = "{binding discount}" verticalalignment = "top" height = "109" width = "109" lineheight = "72" textalignment = "center" fontsize = "18" / >
        < / grid >

    < / grid >
< / usercontrol >
